history.title: Your chats
history.empty: No chats yet. Ask something to start one.
history.retention: Chats are deleted automatically after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
history.retentionNone: Chats are kept until you delete them.
history.private: Only you can see your chats.
history.loadError: Your chats could not be loaded.
history.deleteBody: The conversation "{title}" is deleted permanently. Changes the assistant made stay recorded in the activity log.
history.deleteInProgress: The assistant is still answering in this chat. Stop it first, then delete it.
history.deleteFailed: The chat could not be deleted.

composer.label: Message the assistant
composer.placeholder: Ask lazyit… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer.hint: Type / for commands. Don't paste passwords or secrets. Every change needs your approval.
composer.busyApproval: Approve or reject the pending change to continue.
composer.readOnlyBody: It was started with an earlier AI configuration, or it grew too long. Start a new chat to continue.
composer.hintAuto: Type / for commands. Don't paste passwords or secrets. Auto-approve is on: basic changes apply without asking.

message.unsupported: This part of the conversation can't be shown in this version.
message.emptyTitle: What can I help you with?
message.emptyBody: Ask about your inventory, access or knowledge base, or ask for a change. You approve every change before it happens.

examples.two: Who has access to the VPN?

tools.outcomeUnknown: lazyit could not confirm whether this change was applied. Check the item before trying again.

approval.quoted: Written by someone else — shown as plain text.

warnings.EXTERNAL_PROVISIONING: Creates access in an outside system through an automation.
warnings.EXTERNAL_DEPROVISIONING: Removes access in an outside system through an automation.
warnings.CASCADE_RELEASES_ASSIGNMENTS: Also ends the current assignments of this item.
warnings.CASCADE_REVOKES_GRANTS: Also revokes the access grants tied to it.
warnings.IDENTITY_CHANGE: Changes someone's identity in lazyit (name, email or sign-in).
warnings.CREDENTIAL_DELIVERY: Sends someone a way to sign in.
warnings.LEDGER_APPEND: Adds a permanent record that can't be edited later.
warnings.SOFT_DELETE: Archives it. It can be restored later.
warnings.PUBLISHES_TO_READERS: Makes the content visible to its readers.
warnings.OUTBOUND_INTEGRATION: Changes an outside integration or where lazyit sends data.
warnings.INSTANCE_CONFIGURATION: Changes instance-wide configuration: it applies to everyone from now on.

approval.changed: This change was updated since it was proposed. Review the highlighted points and decide again.
approval.untrustedTitle: Based on content written by others
approval.untrustedBody: The assistant read content other people wrote before proposing this. Check that the change is what you asked for.
approval.elevatedNote: This is a sensitive change. Read it carefully before approving.
approval.passwordHint: Sensitive changes need your password to confirm it's you.
approval.rejectedNote: You rejected this change. Nothing was changed.
approval.expiredNote: This proposal expired. Ask again if you still want the change.

notices.duplicatesUnchecked: The duplicate check could not be completed — you can't read every asset, or a tag or serial number contains a comma and couldn't be looked up. A row whose tag or serial is already taken will be refused when it runs, and the others still run.

table.showing: {shown, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} of {total}

approval.cancelledNote: This proposal was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

errors.stepUpRequired: Enter your password to approve this change.
errors.stepUpUnavailable: Password confirmation isn't available with your sign-in method, so this change can't be approved from the chat. Make it from its page instead.
errors.stepUpRateLimited: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.stepUpRateLimitedNoTime: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.previewChanged: This change was updated since it was proposed. Review it and decide again.
errors.notAwaiting: This change is no longer waiting for a decision.
errors.aiDisabled: The AI assistant was turned off, so this change can't be approved.
errors.stale: The item changed since this was proposed. Nothing was applied; the assistant will check it again.
errors.expired: This proposal expired. Ask again if you still want the change.
errors.alreadyDecided: This change was already decided, maybe in another window.
errors.forbidden: You're no longer allowed to make this change.
errors.unknown: The decision could not be sent. Try again.

auto.title: Applied automatically
auto.note: Auto-approve is on in this chat. The change is recorded like any other, under your name.

run.AI_DISABLED: The AI assistant was turned off.
run.FORBIDDEN: You no longer have access to the assistant.
run.PROVIDER_AUTH: The AI provider rejected the credentials. An administrator needs to check Settings → AI.
run.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider isn't responding right now.
run.PROVIDER_BAD_REQUEST: The AI provider couldn't process this request.
run.PROVIDER_REFUSED: The AI provider declined to answer this.
run.EGRESS_DENIED: lazyit isn't allowed to reach the AI provider. An administrator needs to check the network settings.
run.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The daily AI budget has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
run.CONTEXT_LIMIT: This conversation is too long to continue.
run.MAX_STEPS: The assistant stopped after too many steps. Try a simpler request.
run.ENGINE_RESTART: The answer was interrupted by a restart.
run.RUN_IN_PROGRESS: Another window is already answering in this chat. Showing that answer.
run.CONVERSATION_READ_ONLY: This chat used an earlier AI configuration and is read-only.
run.EXPIRED: A proposed change expired before it was decided.

errors.retryIn: Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

connection.lost: Connection lost. The answer continues on the server.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Higher effort thinks longer before answering and uses more tokens.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: From 0 to 2. Lower is more predictable. Empty uses the default.
temperature.invalid: Enter a number from 0 to 2, or leave it empty.

auto.label: Auto-approve basic changes
auto.description: Basic edits apply without a card. Anything critical still asks for your approval.
auto.badgeTitle: Auto-approve is on: basic changes apply without asking
auto.turnedOn: Auto-approve is on for this chat.
auto.turnedOff: Auto-approve is off. Every change asks for your approval again.

consent.title: Turn on auto-approve for this chat?
consent.intro: The assistant will make basic changes without showing you a card first.

points.basic: Basic edits — creating or updating assets, articles, consumables and similar — are applied right away, with your account and your permissions.
points.critical: Anything critical still asks: roles, identity and sign-in, access grants, credentials, applications marked critical, and other sensitive changes.
points.othersContent: A change proposed after the assistant read content written by other people also still asks.
points.logged: Every change is recorded, under your name, as applied automatically.
points.off: It stays on only in this chat. Turn it off at any time with the switch or /auto off.

errors.locked: The model can't change once the chat has started. Start a new chat to use a different one.
errors.readOnly: This chat is read-only, so its settings can't change.
